latest_release.body:
# v3.3.2

This is mostly a bugfix release, intended to mitigate the impact of some of the online astro collections being offline because of the critical php vulnerability.

Details follow.

Clear skies!

## What's Changed
* fix(config): clean startup error for malformed config.toml (Windows path crash) by @bguthro in https://github.com/smart-underworld/seestar_alp/pull/785
* fix(planner): use the configured location, and the whole horizon in the day chart by @madmanu47 in https://github.com/smart-underworld/seestar_alp/pull/787
* Local horizon profile: planner chart, scheduler skip of hidden targets (#617), visibility API by @madmanu47 in https://github.com/smart-underworld/seestar_alp/pull/788
* ci: run the front-end JS tests (vitest) in the test suite by @bguthro in https://github.com/smart-underworld/seestar_alp/pull/792
* feat(device): expose mount equ_mode only once confirmed from the device by @jaxzin in https://github.com/smart-underworld/seestar_alp/pull/789
* feat(front): serve the web UI under a reverse-proxy sub-path (X-Forwarded-Prefix / root_path) by @jaxzin in https://github.com/smart-underworld/seestar_alp/pull/791
* fix(device): serialize command-id allocation and the scope socket write by @jaxzin in https://github.com/smart-underworld/seestar_alp/pull/790
* Show version in Windows exe properties and startup banner by @bguthro in https://github.com/smart-underworld/seestar_alp/pull/796
* emulator: render S30 / S30 Pro skies at their own plate scale (#795) by @bguthro in https://github.com/smart-underworld/seestar_alp/pull/797
* Treat a peer-closed scope socket as a disconnect in get_socket_msg (#… by @smart-underworld in https://github.com/smart-underworld/seestar_alp/pull/799
* Fix #798 follow-up: real firmware readiness wait + pre-heartbeat reader reconnect by @bguthro in https://github.com/smart-underworld/seestar_alp/pull/801
* Horizon page: make the local horizon from a 360° panorama (follow-up to #788) by @madmanu47 in https://github.com/smart-underworld/seestar_alp/pull/793
* Fix Seestar API misuse found against seestar-spec, and check every request in CI by @bguthro in https://github.com/smart-underworld/seestar_alp/pull/802
* feat(imaging): cached stacked-image snapshot endpoint (GET /<dev>/snapshot.jpg) by @jaxzin in https://github.com/smart-underworld/seestar_alp/pull/800
* Fix Simbad and local target lookups (#803) by @bguthro in https://github.com/smart-underworld/seestar_alp/pull/804
* Updated the Planning page to fix issues introduced by the CDS outage. by @wileecyte in https://github.com/smart-underworld/seestar_alp/pull/805


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/smart-underworld/seestar_alp/compare/v3.3.1...v3.3.2

detail.readme:
# Seestar_Alp

Seestar ALP is a standalone controller, for command, control, and scheduling of SeeStar telescopes.

It uses a webpage based interface running on your computer, to interact with a backend server that controls the telescope.


### Where do I start?

That depends on your goals. (of course)

If you want to get in and learn the code and see how it all works then you can clone this git repository or download the code from the release, or from the main branch.  You will be interested in the ./device and ./front directories at first.

If you just want to use the GUI and commnicate with your Seestar then the standalone install may be right for you. The standalone install is described below.

## Installation

### Standalone package
For details on running pre-built standalone packages, please see the following wiki pages for the most up-to-date details:
- [Windows](https://github.com/smart-underworld/seestar_alp/wiki/Running-standalone:-Windows)
- [MacOS](https://github.com/smart-underworld/seestar_alp/wiki/Running-standalone:-Mac)
- [Linux](https://github.com/smart-underworld/seestar_alp/wiki/Running-Standalone:-Linux)

### Source code
For details on running from source, please see the following wiki pages for the most up-to-date details:
- [Raspberry Pi](https://github.com/smart-underworld/seestar_alp/wiki/Running-from-source:-Raspberry-Pi)
- [Mac](https://github.com/smart-underworld/seestar_alp/wiki/Running-from-source:-Mac)
- [Windows](https://github.com/smart-underworld/seestar_alp/wiki/Running-from-source:-Windows)
